description: This file defines the ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams class within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and encapsulates various filtering criteria for searching claim requests, including employee inclusion options, reference ID, employee numbers, event ID, status, and date range. It also sets default sorting behavior.

classes.name: ClaimRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class that gathers filtering parameters for searching claim requests in the OrangeHRM system. It provides constants to specify employee inclusion options and sortable fields, as well as getter and setter methods for various filter criteria such as reference ID, employee numbers, event ID, status, and date range. The class sets default sorting on construction.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the current value for employee inclusion filter.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the value for employee inclusion filter.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Returns the reference ID filter parameter.

methods.name: setReferenceId
methods.description: Sets the reference ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getEventId
methods.description: Returns the event ID filter parameter.

methods.name: setEventId
methods.description: Sets the event ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date filter parameter.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date filter parameter.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date filter parameter.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date filter parameter, adjusting time to end of day.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers filter parameter.
